description: A needs-you row has no visible way to act. Only the title is a link; row hover underlines the title and the cursor is a pointer for the whole row, but only the title is clickable. The 'Open in Devin' wording exists only in the agent reply. A user who looks for a reply box sees only Ask, which cannot answer Devin.
expected: Row action or link label that says the answer happens in Devin.
suggested_fix: Add 'Open in Devin' text/icon on Needs-you rows or make the whole row a link.

description: After answering in Devin the page gives no sign the answer landed: 'Updated 1m ago' is static, there is no refresh control, and the refresh cadence is undecided. Not observed live (frame is static).
No cue for how long a session has waited beyond the Updated column ('12m ago' vs '1h ago'); an old Needs you looks the same as a new one.
expected: Older waits stand out or sort by wait.
